report_discrepancies.note: The trimmed PDF holds two different proprietary statements of revenues, expenses and changes in net position: p7 (report p10, Modified Cash Basis) ends at net position 1,440,675 (ties to the proprietary Statement of Net Position p6 and the government-wide p1); p16 (report p37) ends at 1,503,448, with beginning 1,431,994, charges 518,178 and operating expenses 452,790. p7 was used for the business-type roll-forward.

The Water/Sewer combining schedule (report p43) ties to the p16 version: Combined Utility charges for services 425,965 vs 427,181 on p7; operating expenses 356,980 vs 345,713; interest expense 1,535 vs 1,699. Detail recorded as printed on p18.

notes: Modified cash basis (recorded as cash). Governmental lines from the Totals column of the governmental funds statement (p4-p5); fund balances 993,251 / 1,044,869 (p5) recorded as fund balance, cash fields null (fund assets are cash, CDs, county treasurer cash and restricted cash, p3). Taxes 480,723 split by the Statement of Activities general revenues (p2), which tie to the General (p11) and Street (p13) tax lines. Intergovernmental 564,211 split by the General Fund (p11) and Street Fund (p13) lines. Miscellaneous 199,308 split by p11, p13, p15 lines plus the Ambulance Board column's 14 (p4). The statement prints the General Fund's net transfer (34,864) on the 'Operating transfers in' row and the nonmajor funds' 34,864 on the 'Operating transfers out' row (labels swapped; Totals net 0); recorded as transfers in 34,864 and out 34,864. Business-type: Combined Utility + Sanitation from p7 (operating + nonoperating); proprietary Miscellaneous 5,000 is counted in Charges for Services on p2. Detail: General Fund combining schedule by department column (p11-p12), Street Fund schedule (p13), nonmajor combining statement (p15, Lottery/Fire Board/Cemetery Board), proprietary Water/Sewer combining schedule (p18) and Sanitation from the p7 column; Ambulance Board fund has no schedule (no detail). The all-funds budget statement (p10) is not recorded (combined across funds; per-fund schedules exist). Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Modified Cash Basis (includes capital assets and debt), per column. Prior-year comparative ending fund balance 993,252 (p3/p5) vs current beginning 993,251 ($1 rounding). Read pages 1-18 of 18
